segment.source: Renders one oversized sentence and nothing else but an optional quiet link — no media, no card, no second action, the type doing all the work. Use it for: brand home pages, agency and studio sites, manifesto and positioning pages, a campaign that lives or dies on a single claim. Prefer 'Product Hero' when the page also has to show the product, and 'Split Text Hero' when the claim needs a supporting paragraph next to it.
